# has procedure step

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasProcedureStep`](gmeow-hasProcedureStep.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasProcedureStep>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a [`Procedure`](../classes/gmeow-Procedure.md) to a step it contains. Specialisation of the universal [`gmeow:hasPart`](gmeow-hasPart.md) spine.
